title: Accounts Payable Automation: Realistic Benchmarks 2026
keywords: invoice processing benchmark error rate straight-through automation market vendor claims
snippet: Median achieved straight-through rate is 68%; vendor-published rates above 95% are rarely reproduced in heterogeneous supplier bases.
content: Our 2026 survey of 240 enterprise finance functions finds a median achieved straight-through processing rate of 68 percent for AP automation deployments in their second year of operation, with an interquartile range of 54 to 79 percent. Vendor-published straight-through rates above 95 percent are rarely reproduced in production environments with heterogeneous supplier bases. Observed post-deployment exception rates cluster between 4 and 9 percent, materially above vendor marketing claims of under 1 percent. Organisations that completed process standardisation before deploying automation achieved straight-through rates 22 percentage points higher on average than those that did not.

title: Why RPA Pilots Fail in Procurement and Finance
keywords: RPA pilot failure process variation standardisation automation finance procurement
snippet: Process variation across regions is the single largest predictor of automation pilot decommissioning.
content: Analysis of 96 robotic process automation pilots finds that process variation across regional operating units is the single largest predictor of pilot decommissioning within 18 months. Pilots deployed onto non-standardised processes were decommissioned at roughly three times the rate of those deployed after a standardisation programme. Governance capacity, rather than capital availability, was cited as the binding constraint on concurrent automation deployments in 61 percent of the programmes surveyed.
